comment: GitHub #147, Kiln clients: player_ui's locked prompt (C 0x2b8430) counts the lock's item with the same InventoryItemCount and marks the prompt locked when it is short (G38UiPlayData +0x2c98 item, +0x2c9c amount, +0x2ca4 locked). locks/client.UiLockCountRet is that call's return address. Client-only UI code: the dedicated server has no player_ui update. Client 26430625 (5d9ef2f1) only. docs/re/locks.md.

locks/client.UiLockCountRet.comment: mov ebx,[rdi+requiredItem]; test; cmp byte [rax],0 (DynamicInteractionLock.destroy); [rsp+0x28] = item; call InventoryItemCount; mov [rsi+0x2c98],ebx; movzx eax,word [rdi+requiredItemAmount]. The return address; kiln-items' mid hook there reads rbp+0x620 (count +0x628) and rdi, which the literal bytes pin. Client 26430625 0x2bc483
